name: Seal of Righteousness
description: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 12 to 40 Holy damage.  Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 96 to 105 Holy damage to an enemy.
buff_text: Melee attacks cause an additional 12 to 40 Holy damage.
